name: Payment Terms
definition: Specifies the payment terms of the obligation.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Specifies that the payment terms apply to an amount.

Percentage.name: Percentage
Percentage.definition: Specifies that the payment conditions apply to a percentage of the amount due.

PaymentTime.name: Payment Time
PaymentTime.definition: Specifies the time of the payment relative to an event such as product delivery or receipt of invoice.

PaymentPeriod.name: Payment Period
PaymentPeriod.definition: Period to which the payment terms apply.

RelatedPaymentObligation.name: Related Payment Obligation
RelatedPaymentObligation.definition: Payment obligation for which payment terms are specified.

RelatedPaymentScheduleType.name: Related Payment Schedule Type
RelatedPaymentScheduleType.definition: Related type of the payment schedule provided in the contract.

RelatedLoan.name: Related Loan
RelatedLoan.definition: Schedule for the payment of the interests due on the related loan.
